attractions.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
attractions.description: Guided sunrise trek up the 1,717 m active volcano with views over Lake Batur, Mount Abang and, on clear days, Mount Agung
attractions.recommended_duration: About 2 hours ascent and 1.5 hours descent
tips: Wear trekking shoes and carry a light jacket or fleece, cap, sunglasses and a small backpack with water and snacks
Summit is cool before sunrise due to mountain breeze

safety_tips.tip: Keep valuables secured, especially at beaches and waterfalls
safety_tips._source_file: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Temperatures at the Mount Batur summit can feel surprisingly cool before sunrise — carry a light jacket or fleece.

For Mount Batur, wear comfortable trekking shoes, a light jacket or fleece, cap and sunglasses, and carry a small backpack with water and snacks. Temperatures at the summit can be cool before sunrise.
